scientific_integrity.nature_of_proof: Complete finite enumeration in two independent graph representations with checked exhaustiveness and all-source shortest-path verification.
scientific_integrity.unproved_limits: Historical publication priority and infinite-family generalizations are not certified.

scientific_limitations: Theorem covers only the explicitly defined Desargues graph and single alternating-cycle trades between Hamiltonian cycles.
No extension to general cubic or generalized Petersen graphs is established.
The historical-priority comparison does not cover all unindexed or inaccessible literature.
title: Sharp decagon mobility and local pentagons among Desargues Hamiltonian cycles
